title: Advance Preparations Sustain Winter Farming Despite Rainfall Shortage in Bale: PM Abiy
desc:
Addis Ababa, November 4, 2026 (ENA)— Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed said advance preparations by the government and the public have helped sustain encouraging winter farming performance in Bale Zone despite concerns over insufficient rainfall.
“We have reviewed the performance of winter farming in Bale Zone. Despite significant concerns over rainfall shortages this winter, good results have been recorded thanks to the advance preparations undertaken by the government and the public,” the Prime Minister wrote on social media pages.
 
PM Abiy emphasized that strengthening economic resilience against both human-induced and natural challenges requires proactive planning, preparedness, and the expansion of available options.
 
“Preparing in advance and expanding options are essential for ensuring that our economy remains resilient and withstands both human-made and natural challenges,” he added.
